description.value: Pedder Bay RV Resort & Marina is a waterfront destination on Vancouver Island about 40 minutes from downtown Victoria, combining an RV park, marina, and general store. The resort sits on the traditional territory of the Sc'ianew First Nation in the Metchosin area and is bike-packing friendly, with bunkies available as a cozy overnight option. The on-site general store and licensed café offer supplies and refreshments in a scenic oceanfront setting.
